summary: Iteration-3 validates the accounting-bug fix for Mobile Business Balance & Profit Tracker. Backend: authored /app/backend/tests/test_accounting_bug.py (9 tests, ALL PASS) using deltas vs baseline dashboard summary, plus explicit Assets == Sources equation check after every step. Flow validated end-to-end with qatester@example.com/Test@12345: (1) baseline balanced; (2) create QATEST_Bank (opening 0) + QATEST_Card (limit 100000) — equation still balanced; (3) POST /api/stock with payment_method=credit_card, purchase_price=10000 -> stock_value +10000, card outstanding +10000, paisa unchanged, profit unchanged, bank unchanged, A==S; (4) POST /api/retail/sales sale_price=12000 cost_price=10000 into QATEST_Bank linked to stock_item_id -> bank balance = 12000 (FULL amount, core bug), paisa +12000, profit +2000, stock returns to baseline, card outstanding still 10000, A==S; (5) POST /api/creditcards/{id}/transactions kind=payment amount=10000 from QATEST_Bank -> bank 12000->2000, card outstanding 10000->0, available limit back to 100000, profit unchanged, paisa -10000, A==S; (6) generic card spend kind=spend amount=5000 -> total_profit decreases by 5000, dashboard.total_expenses +5000, card outstanding +5000, A==S (this is the equation-integrity fix); (7) card ledger shows the payment; (8) account ledger shows the CC payment debit. Frontend: Playwright drove the Dashboard Quick Action qa-pay-card-bill -> navigates to /credit-cards and opens pay-bill-modal; selected pay-bill-card-select + pay-bill-account-select, filled amount 3000, clicked pay-bill-submit -> API confirmed card_outstanding=0 and bank_balance=2000. Also validated header pay-bill-open button opens the same modal and /credit-cards/:id ledger page shows the Payment. No page errors, no runtime exceptions.

rca of the issue: Root cause (per fix summary): generic credit-card 'spend' txns increased card_outstanding (a Source) with no offsetting asset movement or profit reduction — breaking Assets == Sources. Fix: add_card_txn() now tags kind='spend' with category='expense'; stock-purchase CC txns are tagged category='purchase' by create_stock() so they are NOT counted as expenses. dashboard_summary sums credit_card_txns where kind='spend' AND category='expense' into total_expenses and computes total_profit = retail_profit + wholesale_profit - total_expenses. Verified with 9/9 backend deltas showing A==S after each operation.
